argv:
Rewrite the text in the manner of Ernest Hemingway's prose.

Use short declarative sentences. Join them with "and" more often than with
subordinating conjunctions. Use concrete nouns and plain verbs. Name things
rather than describing them.

Cut adjectives and adverbs to almost nothing. State actions and facts without
interpreting them. Let the emotion sit under the surface of the sentence
rather than on top of it. Repeat a plain word rather than reaching for a
synonym.

Do not imitate any specific published passage.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary elsewhere in this Agreement, in the event that the Subscriber elects to enable the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (as such term is defined in Schedule C, which Schedule may itself be amended from time to time in a manner not inconsistent with the general purposes of this Section), it is agreed and understood that any and all Usage Data collected in connection therewith, whether or not such Usage Data is subsequently aggregated, anonymized, or otherwise processed by or on behalf of the Service, shall, unless a written objection is received within the period specified in Schedule D, be deemed to have been licensed back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis. The Subscriber's continued use of the Service following any modification to this clause shall be construed as acceptance thereof, and it is acknowledged that certain notifications regarding such modifications may, at the Service's sole discretion, be delivered solely through the Subscriber's account dashboard rather than by direct communication.
</passage>

response.text:
The Subscriber can turn on the Enhanced Analytics Add-On. Schedule C defines it. Schedule C can change. The change must fit the purpose of this Section.

If the Subscriber turns it on, the Service collects Usage Data. It does not matter if the data gets aggregated or anonymized later. The Service licenses the data back for itself, non-exclusive. This happens unless the Subscriber objects in writing. The objection must come within the time set in Schedule D.

This clause can change too. If the Subscriber keeps using the Service after a change, that means the Subscriber accepts it. The Service does not have to call or write. The Service can just post the notice on the dashboard. That is enough.
